comment: Verification contract for T-004 (high, tdd -- risk-gate-matrix.md requires tdd at high/critical), authored 2026-08-23 because T-004 reached Status: Implementation Complete (commit 56155686, 2026-08-19) without ever being given this file, which structurally prevented the quality gate from reaching this task at all. its authenticity is corroborated indirectly by the fact that the live staged resolve-project-context.py's sha256 (b1bef77b55a6c7a67473fb973f269d780741da6c3473aa40802b7472913109a2, drifted from T-004's own commit-time value only because 82f6dbf2 extended the same file afterward -- see the corrected Outputs table in T-004.md) is traceable through an unbroken git history back to the exact revision the recorded green-sh.log/green-ps1.log (121/0 at commit time) describe. requirement-traceability is a manual check (verification/qg/T-004/traceability.log) because this feature has no traceability.json, only traceability.md -- check-traceability.sh could not be invoked; REQ-001/002/004/005/006/008 confirmed present in requirements.md (grep hit counts recorded in the log), AC-010..015/038/040/041 and their TEST- counterparts confirmed present in acceptance-tests.md, and this task's own four fixture invocations confirmed implemented in tests/resolve-project-context-block-check.py's run_t004_case() function and exercised in the re-run focused-tests logs above. regression (verification/qg/T-004/regression.log) re-ran: git diff --stat/status --short against plugins/ (empty, AC-032), git diff --check (clean), py_compile on the staged .py and both test drivers (clean), the T-001 sibling resolver-evidence-schema suite as an incidental-breakage check (20/20 PASS), human-copy/MANIFEST.sha256 self-verification from within the human-copy root (4/4 OK), T-005's own downstream match suite re-run as a consumer-side non-regression check (37/0 both runtimes), and the FULL tests/run-all.sh/.ps1 sequence run detached with no deadline per this session's own explicit instruction (this deviates from T-003's own contract, which explicitly declined to run the full sequence -- run here because the instructions for this pass required it): sh reports exactly 2 failing suite(s) (deterministic-lane-selfcheck.tests.sh, design-system-contract.tests.sh), ps1 reports exactly 1 (design-system-contract.tests.ps1, since deterministic-lane-selfcheck has no PowerShell twin at all -- confirmed by file-absence and registration-list-absence, a pre-existing structural asymmetry, not a regression this task's diff touches); both failures self-declare DESIGNED-RED for a documented, pre-existing reason (staged CI patch not yet human-applied) and match this repository's own standing baseline exactly. Stack: shell waives lint/typecheck/build -- this task ships stdlib-only Python plus sh/ps1 dispatchers and no compile toolchain is configured for any of the three (tasks.md Global Constraints 'Stdlib-only Python'), matching T-003's own identical justification since both tasks share the same script family. check-component-coverage is correctly ABSENT from this contract's checks: RISK_TIERS['high'] names it, but check-contract.py's CAPABILITY_STATE_GATED_IDS drops it from the tier minimum whenever sdd/project-context.yaml does not exist in this repo -- confirmed absent here. task-state-check and check-workflow-state.sh (a separate, non-contract gate) were both independently re-verified: check-task-state.sh specs/epic-193-a5-capability-resolver/tasks.md returns 'Task state check passed for 10 task(s).' exit 0, and check-workflow-state.sh both with and without --feature epic-193-a5-capability-resolver returns 'workflow-state: ok' exit 0 in both modes -- neither disturbed by this contract's own authoring. Net: T-004's own implementation, tests, and TDD evidence are all independently re-confirmed sound and green by this pass, with no unmet Done When item -- this contract is expected to PASS check-contract.py. SECOND PASS, same day 2026-08-23 (AC-056 remediation): this contract was originally authored before T-005's own contract-authoring pass found AC-056 (diagnostics[] warn/block cardinality) genuinely unimplemented in this task's own _write_evidence, root-caused directly against the production code (contracts/resolver-evidence.schema.json already permitted severity: "warn"; _write_evidence hardcoded severity: "block" unconditionally). tasks.md's own T-004 Requirements/Goal/Scope text names AC-056 among the production behavior this task's own code must implement (T-005 owns only the dedicated test suite); this task was Implementation Complete, not Done, when the gap was found, so closing it is this task's own completion work. Fixed: _evaluate_capabilities now collects one severity: "warn" diagnostics entry per outcome: "warn" DSL-evaluation node (new _iter_warn_nodes helper); _write_evidence/_block gained an optional warn_diagnostics parameter, prepended before the summary severity: "block" entry, defaulting to unchanged behavior for every other diagnostic path. Consequence, disclosed: this legitimately altered diagnostics[] content for T-003's own three dsl-warn-* block-suite fixtures too (the old assertion locked the pre-AC-056 wrong single-entry shape) -- re-running the corrected tests/resolve-project-context-block-check.py against the pre-fix engine (isolated git-clone scratch copy, never reverting the real worktree) reproduced exactly 138 passed / 3 failed for the stated reason (verification/T-004/red-ac056-{sh,ps1}.log); against the fix, 141 passed / 0 failed (verification/T-004/green-ac056-{sh,ps1}.log) -- the same 141/0 total already recorded above (no fixture added or removed, three existing fixtures' own expected-diagnostics shapes corrected). Two directional mutations (a second summary entry; collapsing per-node warn entries into one) were applied only to the scratch clone and are killed by T-005's own new TEST-056 cardinality assertions specifically (see T-005's own contract for the exact assertion names). human-copy/MANIFEST.sha256's own resolve-project-context.py entry was updated to this pass's new sha256 (ca3c95f6...); shasum -a 256 -c from within human-copy/ reports 4/4 OK. Net: no check below changes passes/required value as a result of this second pass (unit-tests/acceptance-tests/regression were already true); their own evidence content is simply fresher and now additionally covers AC-056. FOURTH PASS ADDENDUM (2026-08-23, cross-model panel remediation; this comment's own Third Pass AC-024 update is recorded in T-004.md, not duplicated here): closed three T-004-scope panel findings (late Blocks now carry context_binding/resolver; _draft7_validate now implements not/minimum; _pre_publication_recheck no longer re-labels dependency failures as snapshot-generation-mismatch) -- full RED/GREEN/mutation-kill account in T-004.md's own "Fourth Pass" section (149 passed / 6 failed isolated RED, 155 passed / 0 failed current GREEN, both runtimes; verification/T-004/{red,green}-panel-{sh,ps1}.log). qg/T-004/focused-tests-{sh,ps1}.log re-captured at 155/0 (up from the 141/0 this comment's earlier text describes); every earlier count in this comment (121/0, 107/14, 138/3, 141/0) describes an earlier point-in-time capture, retained for historical continuity, not current evidence. FIFTH PASS ADDENDUM (2026-08-23, same day, cycle-3 cross-model panel remediation): closed T-004's own share of a refreshed two-vendor panel -- three Majors. (1) `_load_governing_schema` now performs a per-artifact `$schema`/`$id` version check (previously only existence+parse), mirroring `registry_discovery.check_capability_registry_schema`'s own identical presence-plus-exact-`$id`-match discipline for the Registry's own schema sibling; new fixture `contract-discovery-failed-governing-schema-wrong-version` (a byte-identical copy of the real resolver-evidence.schema.json with only its own `$id` mutated). (2) A schema read/parse failure no longer interpolates raw exception text into the diagnostic/Resolver Evidence -- only the exception's own class name (e.g. `JSONDecodeError`), never `str(exc)` (AC-014 canonical-sentence rule, security-spec.md B5 no-local-path containment); new fixture `contract-discovery-failed-governing-schema-malformed` (a genuinely malformed JSON schema file). (3) `_pre_publication_recheck`'s Fourth Pass unwrap (already landed, previously disclosed as having 'no dedicated fixture') is now directly tested: new fixture `recheck-dependency-failed` (a `resolve-component-paths` stub succeeding on its first call, step 4, and failing on its second, step 13's own recheck) confirms the failure maps to `affected-component-resolution-failed`, never a re-labeled `snapshot-generation-mismatch` -- mutation-killed by re-wrapping the recheck's dependency calls back into `SnapshotGenerationMismatch` (fails exactly this fixture, 182/2). Also closed: a `draft7-keyword-coverage` meta-assertion (4 checks, one per governing schema) that enumerates every draft-07 keyword each of the four REAL, landed governing schemas (`contracts/{resolver-evidence,context-projection,facet-manifest,capability-summary}.schema.json`) actually uses via a structural schema-tree walk (never a flat string-key grep, which would also match ordinary property names) and fails if any schema uses a keyword `_draft7_validate` does not implement -- confirmed by direct enumeration that no governing schema currently uses an unimplemented keyword (the `not`/`minimum` gaps two prior panel rounds each found one at a time are the only ones that were ever missing, both already closed by the Fourth Pass), converting this class from 'silent, found one keyword at a time' to 'loud, permanently' going forward; mutation-killed by shrinking the test's own independent `DRAFT7_IMPLEMENTED_KEYWORDS` oracle (missing=['minimum'], 183/1). regression.log and placeholder-scan.log (both flagged stale -- two remediation passes behind the reviewed code) were re-captured truthfully against the current tree: git diff --check (clean), py_compile on the staged .py and test driver (clean), tests/resolver-evidence-schema.tests.sh (20/0, unaffected), tests/resolve-project-context-match.tests.{sh,ps1} (98/0 both runtimes, T-005's own downstream consumer suite, now current -- the match-check.py edit from T-003's own cross-model panel remediation is included in this run), plugins/sdd-quality-loop/scripts/check-placeholders.sh against the staged .py and both extended test drivers ('Placeholder scan passed.'), human-copy/MANIFEST.sha256 self-check (4/4 OK, resolve-project-context.py sha256 now f6bc679612fff4b0d35f1770fe1f135339090392ba042ef31ad229426316fbd9), check-task-state.sh (exit 0, 10 tasks) and check-workflow-state.sh --feature epic-193-a5-capability-resolver (exit 0, workflow-state: ok), both re-run directly rather than carried forward. GREEN: 184 passed / 0 failed, both runtimes (verification/qg/T-004/focused-tests-{sh,ps1}.log, byte-identical to verification/qg/T-003/focused-tests-{sh,ps1}.log and verification/T-004/green-cycle5-{sh,ps1}.log -- the shared driver's own current whole-suite total).
